# Stability Study Tracker Skill

> **Category:** Domain Skills > Industry > Life Sciences

## Overview

Use when managing pharmaceutical stability studies including ICH stability protocol design, storage condition monitoring, testing schedule management, shelf-life determination, and stability data trending for regulatory submission.

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [stability-study-tracker-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
stability-study-tracker-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@stability-study-tracker` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Design stability protocols per ICH Q1A: conditions, time points, test parameters
- Track testing schedules with automated reminders for sample pull dates
- Monitor storage chamber conditions with excursion alerting
- Analyze stability data trends: physical, chemical, microbiological

## Industry Standards Applied

- **ICH Q1A(R2)**: Stability testing of new drug substances and products
- **ICH Q1B**: Photostability testing of new drug substances and products
- **ICH Q1E**: Evaluation of stability data for shelf-life determination
